```{r lookup function}
composite_5050_lookup <- composite_5050_lookup %>%
  rename(DOW = '...1')

tibble::column_to_rownames(composite_5050_lookup, var = "DOW")

get_most_similar_lake <- function(Melina_Study_DOWs, composite_5050_lookup, DOW = "DOW6") {
  
  # Ensure lookup row names match the DOW column/row names
  # If DOWs are in a specific column in composite_5050_lookup, set them as rownames:
  # rownames(composite_5050_lookup) <- composite_5050_lookup[[dow_col]]
  
  Melina_Study_DOWs %>%
    mutate(
      # Find the most similar lake DOW
      Most_Similar_DOW = map_chr(.data[[dow_col]], function(dow) {
        dow_str <- as.character(dow)
        
        # Check if the DOW exists in the lookup table
        if (!dow_str %in% rownames(composite_5050_lookup)) return(NA_character_)
        
        # Extract row values for this DOW
        scores <- composite_5050_lookup[dow_str, ]
        
        # Filter for values > 0 (excluding self-match if 0)
        valid_scores <- scores[scores > 0]
        
        if (length(valid_scores) == 0) return(NA_character_)
        
        # Return column name with the minimum score
        names(which.min(valid_scores))
      }),
      
      # Retrieve the minimum score value
      Similarity_Score = map_dbl(.data[[dow_col]], function(dow) {
        dow_str <- as.character(dow)
        if (!dow_str %in% rownames(composite_5050_lookup)) return(NA_real_)
        
        valid_scores <- composite_5050_lookup[dow_str, ][composite_5050_lookup[dow_str, ] > 0]
        if (length(valid_scores) == 0) return(NA_real_)
        
        min(valid_scores, na.rm = TRUE)
      })
    )
}

# Example Usage:
# result_df <- get_most_similar_lake(TreatedCLPLakes, composite_5050_lookup, dow_col = "DOW")
```
